arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Grunder argued the Turner standard applies to prison rights.
She stated California is a hub for race-based gangs.
Mr. Clement argued all race-based policies need strict scrutiny.
Mr. Deixler highlighted the long history of this practice.

paragraphs: California separates prisoners by race to prevent violence. the sides that brought the case argue this violates the Equal Protection Clause. The state claims this policy is necessary for safety.
